# SNN_VisualSemanticDecoder

**Domain**: iNEST

## Definition
A spiking neural network architecture that decodes visual semantic information from fMRI brain activity patterns. Demonstrates how neuromorphic computing can bridge brain imaging and semantic understanding, enabling energy-efficient brain-computer interfaces.
